caption: One decoder step of the worked example: scores 1, 2, 3 become weights 0.090, 0.245 and 0.665, and their weighted average of the three encoder states gives c_t = [0.755, 0.910]. Position 3 carries the most weight, so the context sits close to h₃ = [1, 1]; the same three states are re-weighted at every step.

spec.title: Attention at one decoder step
spec.aria: A vertical flow for one decoder step: the source il fait beau gives three encoder states, scores 1, 2 and 3 are softmaxed into weights 0.090, 0.245 and 0.665, and their weighted sum is the context vector [0.755, 0.910], which the decoder turns into the target it is nice.
